subtitle: Cross-reference for 24/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT, plus the SIX national polls released on the same day, Datafolha BR-00304/2026, Palver BR-09587/2026, PoderData/Aya BR-01739/2026, Alfa Inteligência/TMC BR-02512/2026, Real Time Big Data BR-04202/2026 and Futura/100% Cidades BR-05268/2026, and the press flow of 24/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 43.50% (USD 12.18M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 3.00pp raw and 3.15pp normalised in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.35pp, to 24.50% (USD 0.98M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 43% at Palver, tied, to 38.4% at Futura, 2 points behind, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in one of the six.
fortes: ⭐ RISES 3.00pp IN THE WINNER CONTRACT, to 43.50%, and 3.15pp normalised by the sum of the pair, which stayed practically still, from 99.35 to 99.05. The gap against Flávio Bolsonaro narrows from 18.35pp to 12.05pp, and it is the third day running that it narrows.

🔑 The 6.30pp of this step are the largest narrowing of the gap between two consecutive certified readings since 04/Sep, when this record began, and almost twice the second largest, which was 3.35pp from 21 to 22/Sep.

At Datafolha on 24/Sep, the house with the highest reliability in the table, he leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by 40% to 36% and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 47% to 45%, and it is the only one of the six national polls of the day that puts him ahead head to head.

Measuring each house against its own previous wave, he gained ground in three of the six: Datafolha, where the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) gap widened from 3 to 4 points, Palver, where he went from 1 point behind to a tie, and PoderData, where the lead widened from 1 to 2 points.

🔒 Datafolha measures the decision locked in ten days from the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): 80% of the electorate says it is fully decided, and among his voters the figure is 87%, the highest of the two sides.
fracos: He is still behind in the winner contract by 12.05pp, with 43.50% against 55.55% for Flávio Bolsonaro.
In the series recorded since 14 April his price sits 24.00pp from the top of the series, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 9.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

🔴 He loses ground in three of the six national polls of the day, always against the previous wave of the same house: at Real Time his lead fell from 8 to 4 points, at Futura he went from 0.6 point ahead to 2 points behind, and at Alfa, Exame records a fall from 14 to 7 points in the house own series.

⚖️ In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing he loses in four of the six houses, and at Futura the deficit of 5.7 points, 43.7% against 49.4%, falls OUTSIDE the 2.2pp margin of that poll.

🔴 In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.35pp raw and 2.05pp normalised, to 24.50%, and there the raw figure UNDERSTATES his loss, because the sum of that pair inflated from 97.35 to 100.00.

📰 The messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone, published by Estadão on 24/Sep, reach both sides of the race: on his side, a lawyer reports thanks for whisky sent by the banker and an effort to bring him closer to the government. He replied publicly, at an event in Rio, that a president friend is the people, and not Vorcaro.
candidates.analise: Lula rose 3.00pp in the winner contract, to 43.50% (USD 12.18M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT, and 3.15pp normalised by the sum of the pair, which stayed practically still, from 99.35 to 99.05. ⭐ The gap against Flávio Bolsonaro narrowed from 18.35pp to 12.05pp, the third day running that it narrows after the 22.40pp of 21/Sep, and the 6.30pp of this step are the largest narrowing between two consecutive certified readings since 04/Sep, when this record began. 🗳️ And the day brought SIX national polls, which do not agree about him: in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he goes from 7 points ahead at Alfa/TMC to 2 points behind at Futura, with 4 at Datafolha and at Real Time, 2 at PoderData and a 43% tie at Palver. In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) against Flávio Bolsonaro he leads in one of the six, Datafolha, by 47% to 45%, ties at Alfa and loses in the other four. 🔑 The reading that survives an honest comparison is each house against its own previous wave, and it comes out 3 to 3: he gained at Datafolha, Palver and PoderData and lost at Real Time, Futura and Alfa. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price move to the polls nor to the news: it measures both sides with the timestamp of each one.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 55.55% (USD 11.79M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, down 3.30pp raw and 3.15pp normalised in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rises 4.00pp, to 75.50% (USD 1.14M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 40.4% at Futura, where he leads, to 33% at Alfa/TMC, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six.
fortes: He is still ahead in the winner contract by 12.05pp, with 55.55% against 43.50%, and his price sits 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.

⭐ He leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six national polls of 24/Sep: 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, 48% to 45% at Palver, 46% to 45% at PoderData and 45% to 44% at Real Time, with a 43% tie at Alfa.

📌 The Futura advantage, of 5.7 points, is the only one of the six that falls OUTSIDE the margin of the poll itself, and the house describes it as a statistical advantage. It is not the first time in this base: of the 34 [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) readings between the two already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin and 8 of them favoured him.
⭐ In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he RISES 4.00pp raw, to 75.50%, the largest move of any contract in this round.

He gains ground in three of the six national polls when each house is measured against its own previous wave: he rose 7 points at Real Time, 2.7 at Futura, where he took the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) lead, and Exame records that he cut the distance from 14 to 7 points in the Alfa series.
fracos: 🔴 He gives up 3.30pp raw and 3.15pp normalised in the winner contract, and the gap over Lula narrows for the third day running, from 22.40pp on 21/Sep to 19.05pp, 18.35pp and now 12.05pp.

The 4.00pp rise in the runner-up book is smaller than it looks: the sum of that pair inflated from 97.35 to 100.00, and normalised the move is 2.05pp, that is, the raw figure OVERSTATES his gain there.

He leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in only one of the six national polls of the day, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and sits behind in the other five, with the widest distance at Alfa/TMC, 33% against 40%.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.

On the same day he asked the Supreme Court, in André Mendonça chambers, to investigate the relationship between Lula and Vorcaro, and Folha de S.Paulo records that the request comes from someone who is under investigation in the Dark Horse case.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro gave up 3.30pp in the winner contract, to 55.55% (USD 11.79M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT, and 3.15pp normalised. The gap over Lula narrowed for the third day running, from 22.40pp on 21/Sep to 12.05pp now, and his price sits 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep. ⭐ In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he went the opposite way and rose 4.00pp, to 75.50%, the largest move of any contract in this round, but there the raw figure overstates it: the sum of that pair inflated from 97.35 to 100.00 and the normalised move is 2.05pp. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he leads the first round in one, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six. 📌 The 5.7 point advantage Futura gives him in the second round is the only one of the six that falls outside the margin of that poll, and of the 34 readings of that pairing already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin, 8 of them in his favour. 📰 In the news, the messages from Daniel Vorcaro phone published by Estadão on the day show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, and the panel records the act by the date the material became public, not by the date of the messages.

At Futura he lost third place to Ronaldo Caiado: he fell from 6.5% to 5.6% while the other rose from 4.5% to 5.7%.
In the winner contract he remains at the floor of the book, 0.05%, and is priced below what his cumulative volume would suggest, USD 5.02M.
At Palver, which is the source of the polling side of the divergence chart in this round, he has only 2%.

candidates.name: Renan Santos

fortes: He still leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, with 44.00%, and his lead over Augusto Cury is 4.05pp.

cruzamento: The day has two instruments measuring the same race and they do not say the same thing. 💹 In the winner contract the gap narrowed from 18.35pp to 12.05pp between the reading confirmed on 23/Sep at 11:54 BRT and the one on 24/Sep at 22:45 BRT, the third day running that it narrows after the 22.40pp of 21/Sep. ⭐ That is 6.30pp in a single step, the largest narrowing between two consecutive certified readings since 04/Sep, when this record began, and almost twice the second largest, 3.35pp from 21 to 22/Sep. Lula rises 3.00pp raw and 3.15pp normalised, to 43.50%, and Flávio Bolsonaro gives up 3.30pp raw and 3.15pp normalised, to 55.55%, with the sum of the pair practically still, from 99.35 to 99.05: here the raw and the normalised figures tell the same story, unlike what happened on 23/Sep. 🗳️ SIX NATIONAL POLLS WERE RELEASED ON THE SAME DAY, and they do not agree on who leads either round. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the spread runs from Lula 40% to 33% at Alfa/TMC to Flávio Bolsonaro 40.4% to 38.4% at Futura, passing 41% to 37% at Real Time, 41% to 39% at PoderData, 40% to 36% at Datafolha and a 43% tie at Palver. In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) it runs from Lula 47% to 45% at Datafolha, the only one that puts him ahead, to Flávio Bolsonaro 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, and that is the only one of the six in which the distance falls OUTSIDE the margin of the poll itself. 🔑 The comparison that survives is each house against its own previous wave, and it comes out 3 to 3: Lula gained ground at Datafolha, at Palver and at PoderData and lost at Real Time, at Futura and at Alfa. 📌 An advantage outside the margin in that pairing is not new in this base: of the 34 second round readings between the two already recorded, 11 fell outside the margin and 8 of them favoured Flávio Bolsonaro, including Gerp on 09 and 17/Sep and Futura itself on 17/Sep. 🥉 In the first round third place book almost nothing moved: Renan Santos stays at the same 44.00%, Augusto Cury rises 0.10pp, to 39.95%, and the distance between them narrows from 4.15pp to 4.05pp, in the series 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp and 4.05pp. 🏆 The Renan Santos contract in the winner book is still the one with the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.39M against USD 14.10M for the Tarcísio de Freitas one, and in the runner-up book his also leads on volume, USD 1.36M against USD 1.14M for the Flávio Bolsonaro contract, which is the one priced at 75.50% there. 📰 In the news, the material extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep reaches both sides: it shows four attempts by Flávio Bolsonaro to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, before his arrest on 17 November 2025, and it also shows an effort by a lawyer to bring the banker closer to the Lula government. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation, and the testimony by Vorcaro that was set for 24/Sep was postponed by the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) at the request of the defence. ⛔ The panel does not attribute a price move to a poll nor to an act: it measures both sides with the timestamps of each one.
